name: Asia Neo Tech Industrial Co.,Ltd.
summary: Asia Neo Tech Industrial Co.,Ltd., headquartered in Taoyuan City, Taiwan, is an enterprise specializing in the research, development, manufacturing, and global distribution of advanced automatic drying equipment. The company provides a comprehensive portfolio of machinery, including various hot-air ovens (such as multilayer, conveyor, compact, and N2 models), UV curing systems, and semi-automatic laminating machines. Additionally, their offerings extend to automated coating solutions (e.g., low-pressure spray, electrostatic spray, and roller coating lines), stripping machines, pre-curing ovens, flatting machines, and specialized equipment for applications like LED die bond baking and drying processes involving water glue, film paste, or UV surface modification. Energy-saving machines are also part of their product range. Asia Neo Tech serves a diverse international client base across numerous industrial sectors, notably printed circuit boards (PCB), touch panels, cover lenses, LED production, and renewable energy. The company was established in 1989.
